name: KromiumView
summary: Facade for rendering, zooming, and visual operations.

properties.name: surface
properties.description: The native rendering surface associated with this browser.

properties.name: zoomLevel
properties.description: Gets or sets the current zoom level. (0.0 is 100%, 1.0 is ~120%, -1.0 is ~80%).

properties.name: scaleFactor
properties.description: Gets or sets the manual UI scaling factor (e.g. 1.0 = 100%, 2.0 = 200%).

properties.name: isAutoDetectScaleFactor
properties.description: Whether OSR automatically detects display DPI scaling.

properties.name: scrollMultiplier
properties.description: Scroll sensitivity multiplier for OSR mode (default: 1.0).

methods.name: setZoom
methods.description: Sets the zoom level for this browser.

methods.name: takeScreenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of the current page rendering synchronously.

methods.name: takeScreenshotAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously captures a screenshot of the current page using native capabilities.

methods.name: setAntialiasing
methods.description: Toggles graphics antialiasing on the underlying rendering component.

methods.name: resetScaleFactorToAuto
methods.description: Resets the UI scaling factor to automatically match system DPI.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Triggers the operating system's native interactive print dialog for the current page.

methods.name: printToPdf
methods.description: Generates a PDF of the current page and saves it to the specified path using default settings.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: File path to save the PDF.

methods.name: printToPdf
methods.signature: fun printToPdf(path: String, settings: KromiumPdfSettings): CompletableFuture<Boolean>
methods.description: Generates a vector PDF of the current page and saves it with custom settings.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: File path to save the PDF.

methods.name: sendKeyEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a standardized cross-platform keyboard event into the browser viewport.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: The unified keyboard event to dispatch.

methods.name: setFocus
methods.description: Explicitly notifies the underlying browser rendering engine whether this view has active focus.

parameters.name: focused
parameters.description: True if browser host should receive focus.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the underlying browser rendering surface to the specified dimensions.
